stage1.impression: A moody, coherent world: backlit haze cut into shafts by trunks, one warm sun, a believable pine-litter floor with dapples that agree with the sky. But the speaker is a near-black lump whose lower two thirds sink into the dark ground; only the horn on top reads, the tinted body and its insides are crushed, and the trunks read as smooth CG cylinders against a soft photo plate. Atmospheric and competent, still clearly a render, and the hero does not hold the frame.

blocking_9: The speaker's full silhouette must read against the glow: at least 70 % of the body's height set against smoke at lum 120+, not against ground at lum 35-65
The tinted acrylic must read as tinted, lit glass, not a black box: body lum_median 18-30 with the woofer, lining and edges legible and crush under 4 %
A warm rim on both vertical edges and the top edge of the cabinet (p95 170+ on each), not only the right edge
The smoke wall must glow as the light source of the picture (median 175-210 behind the trunks) rather than a mid-grey sepia haze
Trunks with visible bark relief and colour variation at the near trees; no smooth cylinders
No hard horizon line where the lit floor meets the haze plate (y about 415 across the frame)
A grounded base: litter around the feet and a contact shadow, no bright sliver at the bottom of the cabinet

defects.what: lower body of the speaker sits against dark ground (body lum_median 11.5 vs ground 54-67); the silhouette dissolves below the haze line
tinted body crushed: lum_median 11.5, crush 9.6 %; woofer at lum 13 barely separates from the panel
left vertical edge has almost no rim (median 23, p95 113) while the right edge rims to p95 227; uneven, one-sided outline
bright sliver/triangle inside the bottom of the cabinet catching light, reads as a gap under the box rather than a base on the ground
a hard horizontal seam where the lit modelled floor meets the haze/plate (profile drops 130 to 45 across ~60 px at x 560-620)
near right trunk and the other trunks read as smooth, evenly shaded cylinders with no bark relief; CG
close left trunk is a soft flat dark band with no texture
background plate is soft and low-detail behind the modelled trunks; reads as a blurred photo backdrop
flat dark foreground band (lum_median 27.6) across the full width; dead weight at the bottom of the frame
the glow wall peaks at lum ~148-178; reads as dull sepia haze rather than a luminous backlit smoke wall
monochrome sepia grade; shadows have no cool component (fg b_median 14 vs r 41), so the image reads as a tinted filter

changes.problem: The camera's eye height puts the haze horizon at the top third of the cabinet, so the dark body is set against dark ground and its silhouette is lost.

evidence.measured: falloff profile behind the speaker drops 155 -> 45 at y about 415-450; body lum_median 11.5 against ground 54-67 below that line and against glow 139-165 above it

change.setting: Camera lens height (and shift_y to keep the framing)
change.to: 0.35 m, shift_y +0.08 so the horn keeps headroom; keep 65 mm, verticals level

changes.expected: The haze line drops to roughly the lower quarter of the cabinet; at least 70 % of the body's height stands against glowing smoke, giving the dark silhouette rimmed in light the card asks for.

changes.problem: The smoke stops glowing well above the ground, so even behind the speaker the base of the picture is dark floor rather than lit haze.

evidence.measured: ground behind right of speaker lum_median 54.4; haze above it 165

change.to: 0.14, and move the volume centre from y 8 to y 6 so the densest smoke sits 4-8 m behind the speaker at ground level

changes.expected: A glowing ground-hugging haze continues down behind the speaker's base and softens the floor/haze seam.

changes.problem: The glow wall is a dull mid-tone sepia rather than the luminous light source of the frame.

evidence.measured: lum_median 147.8, p95 172.9; image p99 178, nothing near white

change.to: 0.0 (and sun irradiance 30 -> 36 if the shafts stay under 200)

changes.expected: Haze behind the trunks reaches 175-210 without clipping, shafts read as light, and the silhouette contrast against the body rises.

changes.problem: The tinted acrylic and its contents are crushed to black, so the product reads as a box, not tinted glass with a woofer and lining behind it.

evidence.measured: lum_median 11.5, crush_pct 9.6; woofer region (420,400,515,530) lum_median 13.3, range 16

change.setting: Bounce 2.4 x 2.4 m from azimuth -25, elevation 12

changes.expected: Front face lifts to a deep smoked brown-black with the woofer surround, lining and internal edges legible through the tint; still clearly darker than everything around it.

changes.problem: Only the right edge of the cabinet is rimmed; the left edge and top fade into the background so the outline is one-sided.

evidence.measured: left edge strip median 23, p95 113; right edge strip (530,360,540,600) p95 227

change.setting: Kicker 0.3 x 2.4 m from azimuth -150, elevation 22
change.to: irradiance 42, and widen to 0.5 x 2.4 m

changes.expected: A thin warm line runs the full left edge of the cabinet, matching the right edge, so the silhouette closes.

changes.problem: The trunks read as smooth CG cylinders: the bark tint flattens the texture to a single dark brown.

evidence.measured: centre trunk lum_range 50.6 over its full height, mostly a smooth gradient; near right trunk shows no bark plates at full size

change.to: tinted 30 % toward #1E1A17, bump 9, with a 15 % per-trunk hue/value variation and a grey lichen mask on the lower 1 m

changes.expected: Plated pine bark with visible relief and rim-lit ridges on the sun side of each trunk; the trunks become wood, not tubes.

changes.problem: The grade is one-note sepia: shadows carry no cool skylight, so it reads as a filter rather than early-morning light.

change.setting: Sky fill 1.2 x 1.2 m from azimuth -20, elevation 5

changes.expected: Shadowed floor and the speaker's front take a faint cool cast against the warm shafts, adding depth and separating the planes.

changes.problem: The base does not sit in the litter: a bright sliver shows inside the bottom of the cabinet and the floor is flat around it.

evidence.measured: ground under the base lum_median 35.7 against the floor beside it 54-67; contact profile rises 13 -> 37 within ~30 px, with a lit sliver at (500-535, 598-612)

change.setting: Speaker feet sink and ground scatter
change.from: 10 mm, no scatter at the base
change.to: 20 mm, plus a scatter of pine needles and small cones piled 10-25 mm against the base on all sides

changes.expected: The cabinet visibly rests in the needles with a soft dark contact line; no lit gap under it.

out_of_scope.request: Make the internals behind the tint (amplifier block, lining panels) less boxy and murky
out_of_scope.why: They are the speaker's designed see-through parts and are fixed; only light can change how they read.

out_of_scope.request: The horn's opaque black profile inside the clear head reads as a dark blob from this angle
out_of_scope.why: Speaker shape is fixed and the waveguide shape is set by acoustics; a different camera azimuth could help, but not a change to the part.
